title: add benchmark lab advanced profiling baselines and reporting pipeline
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds the v2 profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and a new reporting pipeline DAG to aggregate results into the benchmark lab dashboard. Motivation: provide stable profiling baselines for cold-start and steady-state runs across representative chat/streaming/embedding workloads and to centralize reporting for easier regression detection. High level changes: 1) profiling baselines runner that captures hardware counters, kernel timelines, and token-level latency slices; 2) representative workload runners (chat, streaming, embedding, rerank) with configurable seed prompts and traffic profiles; 3) reporting pipeline v2 that ingests runner output, normalizes metrics, computes baseline deltas and stores summary artifacts for the dashboard and alerting; 4) CI integration with perf-smoke and nightly baseline comparison; 5) docs and runbook for reproducing baselines and adding new workloads. Checklist: - [x] baseline data model and schema stable; - [x] runner implementations for 4 workload types; - [x] pipeline DAG, processors, and normalization modules; - [x] unit/integration tests added; - [x] perf-smoke flake fixed and retry strategy added; - [x] docs and runbook included; - [x] migration plan for v1 -> v2 pipeline consumption. Rollout notes: deploy pipeline in staging first and run 1 week of nightly baselines, then promote to prod; dashboard pull requests will follow to display baseline deltas and regression alerts.
